decisions.choice: Adding a product to cart does not reserve stock. When the shopper clicks Checkout, Commerce validates authoritative prices and reserves managed stock before redirecting to Stripe. Successful payment keeps stock reserved for the order until fulfillment. An expired unpaid checkout releases its reservation only after the payment outcome is confirmed; an unknown outcome is not treated as unpaid.
